description.value:
You fire a targeted bio-electric pulse through a specialized omni-tool attachment that overloads an organic creature's nervous system.

Requirements The target must be an organic creature.

Choose a qualifying creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-neural-shock] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[electricity]] damage.

Failure The target takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[electricity]] damage and is Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[electricity]] damage and is Stunned 3. Additionally, the target is Off-Guard until the end of its next turn even after the Stunned condition expires.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
